papers.title: High Molecular Weight Fucoidan Loading Into and Release from Hyaluronate‐Based Prefabricated Hydrogel and its Nanogel Particles Controlled by Variable Pitch and Differential Extensional Shear Technology of Advanced Twin Screw‐Based System
papers.abstract: Abstract Efficient incorporation of high molecular weight drug into prefabricated hydrogel and its delivery are big challenges in its applications to drug delivery and tissue regeneration using a 3D bioprinting system. In this work, a new method of loading a model high molecular weight drug (fucoidan with 200 kDa) into prefabricated hyaluronate‐based terpolymeric gel is developed by using an advanced screw‐based extrusion printing system. This system effectively incorporates the fucoidan biomolecules into the prefabricated crosslinked gel within 60 s at significantly higher percentages without much change in gel properties. Less damage in gel network is achieved through variable pitch and differential extensional shear mechanism by optimization of bioprinting conditions. Importantly, fucoidan‐loaded nanoparticles (NPs) are developed using the advanced extrusion system at high screw rpm and with increased residence time using recirculation. The encapsulation efficiency, sustained release of fucoidan, and in vitro cell culture studies confirm the nontoxic nature of the drug‐loaded gels and nanogels at lower doses, exhibiting the biomedical application potentials of this advanced screw‐based extrusion printing system and drug‐loaded NPs formation in pharmaceuticals, 3D bioprinting, tissue engineering as well as maximal drug loading into and sustained release from prefabricated gels.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文未涉及任何人工智能技术，不符合AI生物打印的研究方向。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not incorporate AI/ML into any bioprinting workflow stage; it focuses on mechanical optimization of screw-based extrusion for drug loading.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效负载高分子量药物至预制水凝胶是3D生物打印中的挑战。
summary_zh.method: 采用变螺距和差速拉伸剪切的螺杆挤出系统负载褐藻糖胶。
summary_zh.result: 该方法在60秒内实现高负载且凝胶性质变化小，形成的纳米颗粒具有缓释功能。
summary_zh.validation: 通过包封效率、释放曲线和体外细胞培养验证无毒性和应用潜力。

summary_en.motivation: Efficient loading of high molecular weight drugs into prefabricated hydrogels remains a challenge for 3D bioprinting applications.
summary_en.method: A twin-screw extrusion system with variable pitch and differential extensional shear was used to incorporate fucoidan into hyaluronate-based terpolymeric gel.
summary_en.result: High loading efficiency was achieved within 60 seconds with minimal gel network damage, and nanogel particles exhibited sustained drug release.
summary_en.validation: Encapsulation efficiency, release profiles, and in vitro cell assays confirmed non-toxicity and biomedical potential.
